results.description: When it comes to selling or letting your property, the staff at Sinclair Hammelton understand that no two clients are the same. You will find our adverts in all the main local newspapers, and we also advertise in national newspapers and quality lifestyle magazines where appropriate. Our distinctive offices, which are open seven days a week, are well located in prominent High Street locations at Bromley, Hayes and Petts Wood, which are bright, well lit window displays ensuring a continuous flow of customers. Our property details contain meticulous descriptions and floor plans, and are illustrated with professionally taken photographs to ensure each property benefits from the highest presentation standards.
